name: 01-launcher-stopped
note: Actual Launcher UI opens stopped, with all four components offline and DEMO/Realtime choices visible; no automatic session was started.

name: 02-command-ready-en
note: Command shows all three roles online and system ready; four Mock aircraft, zero real online devices, Singapore tactical basemap loaded.

name: 03-command-language-zh
note: Native Chinese button changes Command labels after Backend confirmation.

name: 04-map-online-3d
note: Native Map shows the Singapore Google/Cesium scene and four labeled Mock UAVs; Chinese preference propagated from Command.

name: 05-map-select-uav02
note: Native Map device menu selects UAV-02 and highlights its marker after Backend ACK.

name: 06-video-map-target
note: Video displays UAV-02 as the acknowledged Map target, propagated Chinese labels, and an explicit no-source state. No playback claim is made.

name: 07-video-independent-four-layout
note: Video selects UAV-03 independently while the active UAV remains UAV-02; native four-slot layout retains the main target and shows three secondary source cards.

name: 08-default-drag-keeps-selection
note: Native left drag across the fleet without enabling box select leaves the acknowledged UAV-02 selection unchanged.

name: 09-box-select-four
note: Button-enabled native rectangle selects all four UAVs after ACK, preserving UAV-02 as primary; Backend video target remains UAV-03.

name: 10-move-ground-clearance-guard
note: 3D move is blocked because the Mock UAV is under the one-metre terrain-clearance threshold; confirm remains disabled and Backend has no execution.

name: 11-mock-lift-preview
note: The explicit Mock lift control creates a vertical preview with editable AGL height and enables confirmation; no motion has been committed.

name: 12-cancel-move-preview
note: Native Cancel removes the lift preview; Backend execution collection remains empty.

name: 13-mock-move-completed
note: A single confirmed Mock lift progressed to completion; the execution monitor and UAV altitude agree. The task completed before the pause attempt, so pause is not counted as verified here.

name: 14-move-paused
note: Native Pause is acknowledged; the execution card shows PAUSED at 50 percent with a Resume action.

name: 15-paused-zoom-stable
note: Native wheel zoom changes the camera while the paused execution position and progress remain identical in two Backend snapshots.

name: 16-move-resumed
note: Native Resume returns the same execution to EXECUTING and progress advances from 50 to 52 percent.

name: 17-empty-plan-validation
note: New-plan dialog keeps Create disabled with an empty name.

name: 18-cancel-new-plan
note: Cancelling new-plan creation returns to the empty list without adding a Backend plan.

name: 19-plan-assignment-saved
note: Native Create produced one draft and mission; selecting UAV-01/02 then Save is acknowledged, clears the dirty banner, and preserves 3 m spacing.

name: 20-route-edit-mode
note: Command opened the corresponding Map edit session; Map hides fleet-move tools, disables 2D/3D switching, and exposes waypoint editing with manual camera hints.

name: 21-route-coordinate-and-zoom
note: Native longitude edit applies to waypoint P04 (103.861780000); manual wheel zoom remains usable during editing without adding a waypoint.

name: 22-dirty-route-exit-guard
note: Native Exit with an unsaved four-waypoint route blocks departure and offers Continue editing, Save and exit, or Discard.

name: 23-route-saved-still-editing
note: Save Draft persists exactly four waypoints and the edited longitude 103.86178, while the Map edit session remains open.

name: 24-route-edit-finished
note: Finish editing closes the Map editor while preserving the saved route; fleet actions remain unavailable during the Command configuration lease.

name: 25-deployed-not-started
note: Native deployment creates one deployment snapshot for the two-UAV/four-waypoint plan; Backend has no execution for this plan until a separate Start action.

name: 26-plan-start-confirmation
note: Starting the deployed mission opens a separate confirmation listing plan, mission, both UAVs, four waypoints, distance and duration; no scheduled start is selected.

name: 27-plan-group-paused
note: Native Command group Pause is acknowledged for both assigned aircraft; Backend confirms two PAUSED executions with one shared plan-route snapshot.

name: 28-map-two-member-mission
note: Native Map shows both mission members paused and a shared mission route presentation; execution state agrees with Command and Backend.

name: 29-map-2d-paused
note: Native 2D switch loads the raster view, preserves paused mission state and selection, and keeps one mission route presentation.

name: 30-group-abort-confirmation
note: After Resume, both members execute again; the first Abort click only exposes Confirm/Cancel, with both Backend executions still EXECUTING.

name: 31-plan-group-aborted
note: After explicit Confirm Abort, both plan members are ABORTED; the UI shows ended-task history actions, and the deployment snapshot remains preserved.

name: 32-launcher-all-ready
note: Actual Launcher reports READY with Backend, Command, Map and Video all online, and the synchronized Chinese preference.

name: 33-launcher-stopped-after-qa
note: Native Shutdown returns Launcher to STOPPED with all four components offline; task-owned UE processes exit and all ownership records are cleared. Backend required the existing stop fallback, which does not resolve the reviewed P2 direct-shutdown issue.
